#!/usr/bin/env bash
# Tagent launcher — put this on your PATH and `tagent` just works.
#
# Install (from the repo root):
#   sudo ln -sf "$(pwd)/bin/tagent" /usr/local/bin/tagent
# or, without sudo:
#   mkdir -p ~/.local/bin && ln -sf "$(pwd)/bin/tagent" ~/.local/bin/tagent
#   (make sure ~/.local/bin is on your PATH)
#
# It resolves the real repo location even through the symlink and starts bun
# with the CLI entrypoint.
set -euo pipefail

# resolve symlinks to find the real script location (repo bin/ dir)
SOURCE="${BASH_SOURCE[0]:-$0}"
while [ -L "$SOURCE" ]; do
  DIR="$(cd -P "$(dirname "$SOURCE")" >/dev/null 2>&1 && pwd)"
  SOURCE="$(readlink "$SOURCE")"
  [[ $SOURCE != /* ]] && SOURCE="$DIR/$SOURCE"
done
REPO_BIN="$(cd -P "$(dirname "$SOURCE")" >/dev/null 2>&1 && pwd)"
REPO_ROOT="$(dirname "$REPO_BIN")"

if ! command -v bun >/dev/null 2>&1; then
  if [ -x "$HOME/.bun/bin/bun" ]; then
    export PATH="$HOME/.bun/bin:$PATH"
  else
    echo "[tagent] bun is required — install it: curl -fsSL https://bun.sh/install | bash" >&2
    exit 1
  fi
fi

# friendly guard: bun's cryptic "Cannot find package 'x'" when deps aren't
# installed (or the install was broken, e.g. under proot/UserLAnd)
if [ ! -d "$REPO_ROOT/node_modules" ]; then
  echo "[tagent] dependencies not installed yet. Run:" >&2
  echo "    bash $REPO_ROOT/scripts/setup-ubuntu.sh" >&2
  echo "  …or use the zero-dependency single-file binary:" >&2
  echo "    https://github.com/asysurya/tagent/releases/latest" >&2
  exit 1
fi

exec bun "$REPO_ROOT/packages/cli/src/index.ts" "$@"
